title: sdks: unify auth/retries/streaming ergonomics and parity, bump SDK versions v1.121.0
author: Priya Shah
release_notes: Unified SDK behavior for auth token refresh and retry/backoff across Python/TypeScript/Go; streaming API ergonomics improved (consistent event model, reconnect/backpressure handling); parity fixes between SDKs and minor API surface rename for ergonomics; bumped package versions to v1.121.0 across SDK repositories.
description: Motivation: multiple SDKs (python/typescript/go) had drift in how auth refresh, retry/backoff, and streaming events were exposed which caused inconsistent behavior for customers and extra maintenance burden. This PR unifies the implementations and ergonomics so feature parity is maintained across languages and prepares for a coordinated release. Summary of changes: 1) Auth: centralize token refresh hook semantics and introduce a single "refresh_callback" contract across SDKs; ensure background refresh does not race with request-time refresh and surface clear retry semantics. 2) Retries: align retryable error classification and default backoff (exponential with jitter, max attempts configurable), add idempotency hints and a common RetryPolicy config. 3) Streaming: standardize streamed event types (data|error|done|heartbeat), add reconnect/backpressure strategies, expose both async iterator and event-emitter styles where language-appropriate, and make streaming cancellation deterministic. 4) Parity/ergonomics: minor API name adjustments for consistency (e.g., Client.stream -> Client.stream_events in TS/Go; kept Client.stream in Python but added alias), unify option names (max_retries/maxAttempts -> max_attempts). 5) Tests and docs: add cross-language integration tests and update README examples. Checklist: [x] implement unified auth hook in python/sdk; [x] implement unified auth hook in ts/sdk; [x] implement unified auth hook in go/sdk; [x] add RetryPolicy and defaults; [x] streaming API parity tests; [x] e2e smoke tests against local serving; [x] update changelogs and bump versions. Backwards compatibility: kept backward-compatible aliases where possible and documented breaking changes when unavoidable. Migration notes: recommend users to switch to new option names over one release; client-side aliases will be kept for 2 releases. CI: full matrix passed after fixing flaky stream reconnect test. Merge: squash-merged to main and cut SDK v1.121.0 releases in Python/TS/Go.
